title: flight toggle
description:
You know it is annoying to fly when you dont want to. This mod fixes that. 
It allows you to toggle the ability to fly. You can change a gamerule to allow flight without admin privileges.
body:
**The idea**

This mod was originally made because it is very annoying to fly in when you dont want to, and this mod fixes that

**Requirements:**

Fabric api.

**Warnings**

WARNING: /fly currently doesnt work in command blocks.

**1.0.1 changelog**

In version 1.0.1 there is a new command,
/fly status.

**What it does**

This mod allows you to toggle the ability to fly in any gamemode including spectator mode.

**Commands**

/fly allows you to toggle the ability to fly, with /fly on or /fly off.
Use /fly status to see if you can use /fly without admin privileges or not(covered in changelog).

**Gamerules**

The gamerule GameRules.NoCommandsOnFlight is by default false,
when true it gives permission to use /fly on or off without admin privileges.

**Feedback info**

Please report feedback and bugs.

For example changing the command name.
